title: Improving Transformer Interpretability with Activation Contrast-Based Attribution

contributions.purpose: 揭示现有基于激活的归因(activation-based attribution)方法为何解释质量受限
contributions.mechanism: 分析激活信息, 观察到基于激活的归因方法可能把与类别无关(class-irrelevant)的特征纳入归因图, 从而降低质量
contributions.evaluation: 定性观察 + Figure 1 逐层热图对比(AttCAT vs Contrast-CAT), 作为方法动机
contributions.domain: Transformer 可解释性 / 文本分类
contributions.source_quote: We observe that activation-based attribution methods for transformer-based text classification models may incorporate class-irrelevant features within activations, potentially degrading attribution quality.

contributions.purpose: 生成更清晰、更忠实的 token 级归因图
contributions.mechanism: 提出 Contrast-CAT: 一种激活对比(activation-contrasting)框架, 用目标激活与多个不同类别的参考激活之差来过滤类别无关特征, 再结合梯度信息构造 token 级归因图
contributions.evaluation: 见 C3 的定量结果; 消融对比 'Random'(随机参考) 与 'Same'(同类参考) 版本, 论证用不同类别激活作对比参考是关键
contributions.domain: Transformer 可解释性 / 文本分类
contributions.source_quote: We propose Contrast-CAT for generating token-level attribution maps based on a novel activation-contrasting framework tailored for transformer architecture. Unlike existing activation-based attribution methods, Contrast-CAT leverages differences between target and multiple reference activations to reduce class-irrelevant features in the target activation, thereby improving attribution quality.

contributions.purpose: 实证 Contrast-CAT 相对 SOTA 归因方法的优越性
contributions.mechanism: 在多数据集/多模型上用 AOPC 与 LOdds 忠实性指标, 在 MoRF 与 LeRF 两种设定下对比 attention-based / LRP-based / activation-based 共十余种方法(RawAtt, Rollout, Grad-SAM, Full/Partial LRP, TransAtt, CAT, AttCAT, TIS 等)
contributions.evaluation: 跨 BERT/DistilBERT/RoBERTa/GPT-2 与 SST2/AgNews 等数据集; 相对次优方法, MoRF 下 AOPC/LOdds 平均提升 x1.30 / x2.25, LeRF 下 x1.34 / x1.03; Table 1 中两种设定均 top-1
contributions.domain: Transformer 可解释性 / 文本分类
contributions.source_quote: We provide experimental results demonstrating that Contrast-CAT significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving average improvements of x1.30 and x2.25 in AOPC and LOdds under the MoRF setting, and x1.34 and x1.03 under the LeRF setting, compared to the second-best methods.

self_declared_provenance.quote: These maps are generated by AttCAT (panel A), which applies gradients to activations, and Contrast-CAT (panel B), which applies gradients to activation contrast information.

This work focuses on activation-based attribution, which leverages a model's activation information to generate attribution maps, achieving state-of-the-art performance in attribution quality thus far.

notes: 方法明确定位为对已有 activation-based 归因(尤其 AttCAT, Qiang et al. 2022)的改进——把'对激活求梯度'换成'对激活对比信息求梯度'。整体报告为正向结果, 全面 top-1。可注意的弱信号: LeRF 设定下 LOdds 仅提升 x1.03(近乎持平, 远小于 MoRF 的 x2.25), 说明优势在不同评测设定下不均衡; GPT-2 上部分方法 N/A(不适用)。paper under review(reject)。
